finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `fwrd35-n1 RD Bench Ticket`, Ref **RD-1015**, customer Marlow Bakery, initial status Draft. Only the Title field was required on the New ticket form (Customer was optional).

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd35-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25%, qty 1. Computed price: **$125.00** ($100 × 1.25).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd35-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25%, qty 1. Computed price: **$250.00** ($200 × 1.25). Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup still 25%, qty 1) via the part row's Edit button → "Edit part" dialog. Computed price afterwards: **$187.50** ($150 × 1.25). Ticket total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket ended in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned.** The first attempt at "Mark Ready" was blocked by an alert reading verbatim:
> "Ticket is not ready
> Part "fwrd35-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier
> Part "fwrd35-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

I satisfied it by editing both parts to set Supplier = "Bench Supply Co" (all other values unchanged). "Mark Ready" then showed a "Ready?" confirmation dialog, which I accepted, and the status displayed as **Ready** (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts removed (each via its Delete button, confirming a "Confirm" dialog with "Delete part"). Parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with 0 parts. Ticket archived via the "Archive ticket" button (no confirmation dialog; button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Verified: RD-1015 does **not** appear in the default active list (13 tickets, RD-1004–RD-1014), and appears only with "Show archived" checked, with an "Archived" badge, status Ready, parts count 0. Nothing created by this run remains active.
